results.name: HTML Utils - Formatting and Safety Fallback
results.setup: Pure function call with sample HTML strings
results.steps: Pass valid HTML and short collapsed HTML to safeFormatHTML.
results.expected: Valid HTML is formatted with tag separation. Short/collapsed HTML triggers safety fallback returning original string.

results.name: Common Utils - Coordinate, Value, CSV, and RunId Parsing
results.setup: Pure function calls with various input strings
results.steps: Test parseCoords, parseValue, parseCsv, and sanitizeRunId.
results.expected: Coordinates parsed to {x,y}, values converted to numbers/booleans, CSV parsed to objects, RunId sanitized.

results.name: Cron Parser - Validation, Presets, and Ranges
results.setup: Call cron parser functions with preset and cron string expressions
results.steps: Validate presets, cron fields, next run dates, and invalid out-of-range cron strings.
results.expected: Presets resolve correctly, valid crons calculate next run, invalid crons throw or return false.

results.name: URL Utils - SSRF Protection and WebSocket Origin Validation
results.setup: Validate various target IPs and WebSocket origins
results.steps: Test isPrivateIP against public and restricted private IPs, test isValidWebSocketOrigin for loopback addresses.
results.expected: Private IPs return true, public IPs return false. Loopback WS origins return true.

results.name: Proxy Utils - Configuration Normalization
results.setup: Pass raw proxy strings and objects to normalizeProxy
results.steps: Normalize proxy strings with null/empty credentials, verify username/password converted to undefined.
results.expected: Falsy username/password mapped to undefined, valid server/credentials retained.

results.name: User Agent Settings - Selection and Rotation
results.setup: Call selectUserAgent with rotation flag true/false
results.steps: Verify static default user agent and rotated user agent selection.
results.expected: Returns non-empty User-Agent string from allowed browser user agent list.

results.name: Health Check API - Endpoint returning status OK

results.name: Auth Setup & Login Lifecycle
results.steps: Check setup status via GET /api/auth/check-setup, setup admin user if needed, and POST /api/auth/login.

results.steps: GET /api/schedules.

results.name: Scheduler - Schedule State Updates & Next Run Calculation
